name: huddling-detector
notes: DBSCAN over normalized bird centroids ([0, 1] image coords). `eps` is the cluster radius — 0.05 ≈ 5% of frame width. `min_samples` is the minimum bird count for a cluster. Per-zone overrides go in `zone_overrides`: { "zone-A": { "eps": 0.08 } }. Tune per-camera after a week of real footage.
